Sam: Heads up — AE asked for an invoice-only pilot for Marina Logistics. They want Dedicated capacity for 3 months at 25% off list. PO coming today, procurement requires an invoice (no credits). Can finance approve sending invoice?
Ava: What's the math? need monthly list price and total for 3 months. 25% feels steep for a pure pilot with no commit.
Sam: List = $36,000/mo. With 25% off -> $27,000/mo => $81,000 total. No long-term commit in their PO. Competitive pressure — they were quoted ~30% elsewhere.
Priya: AE context: Marina is a priority EMEA ops customer, pilot is gating an enterprise rollout. They won't accept credits or conditional refunds due to their audit rules.
Marco: Reminder: discounts >20% need RevOps + CFO approval per deal-desk policy. Also request a billing code tag so we can track pilot discounts separate from other credits.
Lena: Legal: if Finance approves, we need SOW language limiting the pilot term to 3 months and stating conversion requires a separate committed agreement. Include data handling clause and limited liability for the pilot.
BillingBot: billing-bot created draft invoice INV-2026-0472 for $27,000/month. Draft link: https://billing.internal/invoices/INV-2026-0472
Ava: Margin check: at 25% off margin is thin if usage spikes. Need a token cap or auto re-rate beyond X tokens/day (suggest 150k/day cap). Sales should get that in the PO amendment.
Sam: AE to ask for daily cap and auto re-rate. Will push procurement to accept re-rate clause.
Diego: (CFO) I can approve up to 20% pilot discount for 3 months contingent on: 1) token cap added, 2) SOW with Legal's clauses, 3) invoice tagged with "pilot-discount" for tracking. For 25% we need Exec Rev sign-off; Sam escalate with strategic upsell thesis and ARR upside.
Priya: I'll tag the invoice and set a monthly reconciliation checkpoint for usage vs cap.
Ava: If Exec signs off, I'll finalize invoice and document credit memo process if they later convert.
Sam: Okay — escalating to Diego with forecasted ACV uplift and EMEA priority note. I'll upload amended PO when I have it. :thumbsup:
